findings: CLI validation only: --import must be DLL!NAME, --dll a bare name, and unmatched selectors exit 2 instead of printing a zero count. No new I/O beyond reading the image already passed in, no exec, no obfuscation, no hidden Unicode, no CI or submodule change. The selector check parses the image a second time (pe_inspect.PeImage) - a cost note, not a security one.
